name: Saotome Chigusa
source:
A new teacher at St. Eichi Academy. She is passionate about education, but a bit naive and fastidious.

She believes that she can communicate with any student if she is firm in her educational philosophy and treats them with a resolute attitude.

Although she has had relationships, she was raised in an old-fashioned family and is determined to remain a virgin until marriage.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/jyokyoshi/index.html]official site[/url]]
